messages:
ops-bot: paging: high error rate from decode-pool-7 -> GPU OOMs on streaming decode (CUDAError: out of memory). auto-quarantine engaged for nodes g7-12,g7-14 at 17:03 UTC. @oncall_alert sent.
Miguel R.: taking this. grabbing logs & stack traces. any customer-facing impact yet?
Jordan (CS): just received one support ticket, user reported truncated responses and 503s around 17:02 UTC, small set of requests dropped. I'll prep a short customer note once we have scope.
Priya K.: looking at node metrics — KV cache grew rapidly from a few MB to 1.2GB per request due to a malformed prompt stream. suspect runaway generation (max_tokens not respected by client header).
Anna S.: confirmed CUDA OOM stack in /var/log/decode/runtime.log on g7-12: "CudaError: cuMemAlloc failed" then container restarted by k8s. repeated ~6x for that pod.
Miguel R.: immediate mitigations: 1) enable per-request max_token enforcement at ingress (throttle to 512) 2) push a temporary routing rule to route streaming to fallback-compact variant (quantized) 3) cordon and drain g7-12,g7-14 for investigation. Priya can we do 1+2 fast?
Priya K.: on it. applying ingress header enforcement now: 
```
# nginx snippet
if ($http_x_max_tokens > 512) {
  return 403 "max_tokens_exceeded";
}
```
Deploying rule to edge fleet (staged).
Miguel R.: deploy-bot, can you start canary for routing rule to route 10% traffic to model:opt/compact-1.0?
deploy-bot: canary started (10% traffic -> compact-1.0), completion target 30s.
infra-bot: g7-12,g7-14 cordoned. evicting pods (graceful) and creating replacements on g7-15,g7-16.
Anna S.: replacement pods launched but some still hitting OOM in fallback — looks like requests with enormous stop sequences bypassing header. seeing huge attention windows.
Miguel R.: add temporary token limiter in decode service: hardcap generation at 1024 tokens server-side (failsafe). Priya please patch and restart decode-deploy 3/3.
Priya K.: patch applied. rolling restart started (3 pods) — should complete in ~45s.
Jordan (CS): got update: impacted customers ~4 active sessions, some API consumers got 5xx. drafting note to affected customers: short explanation + mitigation.
Miguel R.: also put a conservative circuit-breaker: if a worker observes >2 OOMs in 5m, mark node quarantined and shift its traffic to Dedicated fallback. infra-bot please adjust routing policy.
infra-bot: routing policy updated, quarantined nodes removed from pool.
Anna S.: tracing shows request id rq_8a3f6 had no max_tokens header and payload included a recursive prompt that expands. we should add telemetry alert for missing/invalid max_tokens moving forward.
Miguel R.: agreed. action items: (A) permanent ingress validation for max_tokens + default cap, (B) server-side hardcap at 1024 as safety net, (C) add telemetry alert for missing/invalid header, (D) run offline eval on compact-1.0 to validate quality regression for routed traffic. I'll file followups.
Priya K.: rollouts finished, ingress rule active fleet-wide. CPU fallback capacity handled remaining requests, error rates dropping to baseline by 17:12 UTC.
Jordan (CS): customer note sent to the 4 affected tenants at 17:18 UTC. one customer replied asking if we can whitelist their internal tooling — they'll provide sample payloads.
Miguel R.: handing off to next on-call @Anna S. for postmortem + followups. I'm going offline in 10m. summary: root cause = malformed/malicious prompt bypassing client-side max_tokens -> runaway generation -> per-pod KV growth -> CUDA OOM -> pod restarts -> request drops. mitigations = ingress header enforcement, server hardcap, quarantine/quorum routing, canary route to quantized model.
Anna S.: taking. will collect logs, timeline, and create incident ticket INC-2025-054. set priority to P1 until postmortem complete.
ops-bot: incident resolved for user traffic at 17:20 UTC (error rate <= baseline). followups: postmortem due in 48h, exec summary for CS & SRE rotation.
Miguel R.: thumbs up :thumbsup: Good job team. Priya/Jordan please coordinate the whitelist sample ingestion and test harness.
Jordan (CS): noted — will get samples and open a secure upload to S3.
Priya K.: adding unit tests in ingress validator and a infra alert runbook.
Anna S.: saved. closing live handoff.
